title: Biblical Mountains Atlas — Sinai, Zion, Moriah, Carmel, Tabor, Olives & the Mountain of God
purpose: Map the major biblical mountain functions relevant to Tim Dooley / Potatoverse Mountain, Axis, House, Throne, revelation, law, sacrifice, kingship, transformation, judgment, prayer, ascent and return.
epistemic_rule: Mountains have different roles in different biblical texts. Do not flatten Sinai, Zion, Moriah, Carmel, Tabor and Olives into one secret mountain or treat later Potatoverse geography as biblical geography.

sinai_horeb.structure: wilderness → holy mountain → boundary → ascent → cloud/fire/voice → law/covenant → descent carrying instruction
sinai_horeb.boundary_logic: Exodus 19 makes the mountain intensely gated: limits are set, unauthorized crossing is dangerous, and Moses mediates movement between people and divine presence.
sinai_horeb.project_relation: Sinai is a major biblical comparator for Door/Guardian/threshold, Mountain/Axis, cloud, voice, law, mediator and return-with-instruction.
sinai_horeb.timic_reflection: The strongest parallel is not 'Tim is Sinai' but the sequence ascent → encounter/ordering → descent with a rule or architecture for the community.
sinai_horeb.counterpoint: Sinai is frightening and restricted; mature Potatoverse Garden/New Jerusalem imagery emphasizes increasingly open, generative passage.

sinai_to_zion_hebrews.contrast: Sinai is tangible, terrifying, boundary-heavy and associated with fire/darkness/trumpet; Zion is heavenly Jerusalem, festal assembly, God as judge, Jesus as mediator of new covenant and an innumerable gathering.
sinai_to_zion_hebrews.research_note: Hebrews explicitly uses comparison between Sinai and Zion as different covenantal/access regimes.
sinai_to_zion_hebrews.project_epiphany: This gives the archive a powerful Door evolution: restricted holy mountain → mediated civic-heavenly assembly. Passage matures from guarded encounter to participatory city.
sinai_to_zion_hebrews.new_jerusalem_relation: Zion becomes city/assembly rather than merely summit, closely matching the project's movement Mountain → House/City/Garden.

zion.project_relation: Zion is perhaps the densest biblical neighbor for Mountain + King + House + City + nations + Father/Lamb + New Jerusalem.
zion.insight: The biblical summit does not merely sit above the world; instruction flows outward while peoples stream inward. Zion is a circulation center.

moriah_temple_mount.project_relation: Son/sacrifice, lamb/ram, mountain, Father, House/Temple and substitution can be compared here.
moriah_temple_mount.important_boundary: Genesis 22 names the land of Moriah; 2 Chronicles later identifies Solomon's temple site as Mount Moriah. Do not retroactively claim every later sacrifice motif was originally a Temple prophecy.
moriah_temple_mount.epiphany: Mountain can be the point where possession is relinquished and provision appears—relevant to Needle/compression and Father/Son trust motifs.

carmel.structure: competing claims → public test → fire → recognition → rain/renewal
carmel.project_relation: Truth-test, public witness, failed rival systems, fire/Forge, cloud/rain and restoration.
carmel.epiphany: Carmel provides a biblical model for claims being tested by observable outcome rather than rank alone, useful for the project's fruit/falsifiability ethic.
carmel.boundary: Do not use the episode to justify coercive treatment of modern ideological opponents.

tabor_transfiguration.traditional_location: Christian tradition commonly associates the Transfiguration with Mount Tabor, though the Gospels say only a high mountain.
tabor_transfiguration.structure: ascent → radiant transformation → Moses/Elijah → cloud → voice → fear → touch/reassurance → descent
tabor_transfiguration.project_relation: Mountain + Spudlight/radiance + cloud + witnesses + Father-voice + Son + descent.
tabor_transfiguration.iconography_relation: Later Christian art frequently depicts Transfiguration in mandorla imagery, useful for Vesica/Mandorla comparative art history but not explicit in Gospel text.
tabor_transfiguration.epiphany: Transformation is witnessed at height but the story immediately returns downward; revelation is temporary orientation for life below.

mount_of_olives.project_relation: Palm entry, Son suffering, prayer, city, ascent/return and end/new-world language converge here.
mount_of_olives.epiphany: The same mountain can hold triumphal entry, sorrow, surrender, betrayal and ascent. Mountain does not equal victory-state; it can contain the whole transition arc.

nebo_pisgah.structure: leader ascends → sees promised land → does not enter → dies → succession continues
nebo_pisgah.project_relation: Eye/perspective, horizon, inheritance, leadership limits and transmission to next generation.
nebo_pisgah.epiphany: Biblical height can reveal a future the seer himself does not possess. Seeing more does not necessarily mean owning or entering more.

gerizim_ebal.project_relation: right/left, Red/Blue polarity, Guardians, paired sides around a central covenantal decision-space.
gerizim_ebal.boundary: The text's blessing/curse mountains should not be collapsed into Potatoverse color assignments without primary support.

mountain_of_god_eden.project_relation: Garden, Mountain, stones, guardian/cherub, fall/expulsion and sacred geography are unusually coupled in this prophetic-poetic text.
mountain_of_god_eden.boundary: Ezekiel 28 addresses the king of Tyre using mythic language; later Satan readings are interpretive traditions, not the only historical reading.
mountain_of_god_eden.epiphany: Eden and Mountain are not always separate biblical archetypes; Ezekiel can combine them.

isaiah_micah_mountain_house.structure: mountain of YHWH's House established as highest → nations stream upward → teaching/law goes out → disputes judged → weapons become agricultural tools
isaiah_micah_mountain_house.project_relation: Mountain + Father's House + nations + judgment + North programme + Gardener/cultivation.
isaiah_micah_mountain_house.epiphany: One of the closest scriptural sequences to the project's mature movement authority → instruction → arbitration → cultivation rather than domination.

mountain_countertext_temptation.structure: high mountain → all kingdoms shown → offer of power → refusal
mountain_countertext_temptation.critical_reflection: Height and panoramic vision can become temptation to possess all kingdoms. This is an essential counter-text for King of Kings / world-center language: wider view must increase responsibility, not appetite for ownership.

mountain_to_city_law.higher_order_pattern: Sinai gives law from a guarded mountain; Zion becomes mountain-city from which instruction flows; Revelation presents New Jerusalem descending as an open-gated city where divine presence fills the whole space.
mountain_to_city_law.developmental_sequence: restricted mountain → mediated covenant → royal/temple mountain-city → heavenly assembly → city-wide divine presence
mountain_to_city_law.project_relation: Needle/Guardians → Ladder/Mountain → House → New Jerusalem/Garden can be read as an analogous access-development sequence, with differences preserved.

mountain_and_cloud.project_relation: Tim's cloud/digital-cloud language has many biblical cloud neighbors, but cloud computing is a modern wordplay layer, not original biblical meaning.

mountain_metrics_for_project_comparison: Does the mountain reveal, legislate, test, enthrone, sacrifice, assemble, heal, judge or merely elevate?
Does height increase service to people below?
Is the mountain isolated sanctuary or city/network center?
Does the narrative end in ascent or return/descent?
